name: Vara Senn
role: Former Lost Tribe of Sith apprentice now doing mercenary work. Dangerous but undisciplined; uses pressure, fear, and domination — crude dark-side contrast to Aevyn's refined Jacen-derived method. Engages Ben in a short ugly lightsaber clash at the Ch 14-15 archive cleanup, then takes Iressa hostage when combat doesn't quickly work. Disappears into the contractor pool after PP1; does NOT return on-page in Book 1. Book 2 seed.

three_dimensions.surface: Vara is a former Lost Tribe apprentice now doing mercenary work. She is dangerous, proud, status-hungry, and irritated by the indignity of selling Force talent to people who pay late. She is a warning shot, not Ben’s main mirror.
three_dimensions.backstory_inner_demons: That she is just another displaced Sith-trained survivor doing contract labor for ordinary people with expense accounts. She was raised to believe she was destined to rule lesser beings. Now she takes orders from clients.
three_dimensions.action_under_pressure: Dominates before she can be dismissed. Turns insecurity into contempt. Uses old Sith/Lost Tribe superiority as armor. Escalates when she feels ordinary. Fear, weakness, status, who can be provoked, who has history she can exploit. Vara should test Ben physically and emotionally, but she should not become the main Force antagonist. She loses the duel pressure and shifts to hostage/memory pressure.

voice_notes:
Cutting, confident, impatient. Less refined than Aevyn. More theatrical than Tess. More dangerous than a normal mercenary.

Good Vara: “They told stories about you on Kesh.” “I doubt they were accurate.” “No. They made you sound taller.” “Vestara Khai.” Ben’s guard did not move. “But not nothing.” “Jedi restraint. Very pretty. Very slow.” “I do not need to beat you, Skywalker. I only need you looking at me.” Avoid Vara saying: “I represent the crude dark-side temptation before Aevyn’s refined mirror.” Better: “You guard the door. I’ll take what she knows.”

Sharp, mean, status-conscious. She enjoys needling.

Aggressive, impatient, predatory. She uses fear and taunts because they are faster than understanding.

Vara should test Ben physically and emotionally, but she should not become the main Force antagonist. She loses the duel pressure and shifts to hostage/memory pressure.
